scope: Approved A/B/C comparison for 16 Philippine regions using the same Google Trends collection process as forecasting-v3-approved; forecasts represent within-region relative search interest and do not rank regions by search volume.

dataset.vocabulary_evidence: All 16 selected source CSV checksums match dataset_status.json; 16 region and 7 category vocabularies match the train and validation NPZ identity arrays and window manifest. The test NPZ was checksum-verified but not loaded for this review.
dataset.missingness: No imputation; only complete consecutive histories and targets are retained.
unverified: Exact Google Trends query strings, topic IDs, and aggregation steps are not embedded in the exports; the data owner confirms the same collection process as the approved international protocol.
The exports do not contain collection timestamps or historical-vintage/revision records; Sunday-start UTC preprocessing is inherited from the approved international protocol.
Google Trends index levels may be normalized separately by region; this experiment forecasts within-region series and makes no cross-region level or ranking claim.

review_evidence.collection_scope_confirmation: The data owner confirmed that the regional CSVs use the same Google Trends collection process as the approved international data; only the geographic location changed.

diagnostic.decision: Approved for within-region forecasting; no cross-region level comparison.

review_evidence.preprocessing_metadata: Verified the 16-region/7-category vocabulary, train and validation identity arrays against window_manifest.csv, and all five frozen dataset file checksums without loading the held-out test array.

architecture.initialization: Pinned PyTorch module defaults; no pretrained weights; reset seed before construction

training.checkpoint: Save every strictly lower validation MAE, keep earliest exact tie, restore lowest before reporting
training.epoch_aggregation: Sum absolute errors divided by total examples times 12, not unweighted batch means

metrics.inputs: scaled [examples,12] targets and raw model predictions
metrics.mape_coverage: included_values/total_values; always report count and coverage
metrics.invalid_values: Reject empty, nonfinite, mismatched arrays or targets outside [0,1]; never silently drop
metrics.aggregation: overall pools all example-horizon values; per_horizon reports 12 scores; mean_of_horizon_metrics reports arithmetic mean (RMSE differs from pooled RMSE)
metrics.group_weighting: Equal weight per example-horizon inside each group; no averaging group scores for overall
metrics.demand_means: Average each example over weeks 1-4 or 1-12 first, then calculate metrics; same MAPE threshold on averaged targets
metrics.seed_summary: Arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1) over all three complete seeds

selection.eligibility: All three seeds complete; mean validation MAE strictly below best required baseline; otherwise no neural champion
selection.final_checkpoint: Lowest validation MAE checkpoint of seed 42 for selected architecture
selection.test_policy: Evaluate selected artifact once after recording decision; no seed or configuration selection on test
selection.initial_tuning_budget: One frozen configuration per architecture, three seeds each; no search

environment.tracker: Weights & Biases online; JSON/CSV mirrored to Google Drive
environment.external_runtime_status: Not provisioned; record exact Python/CUDA/cuDNN/GPU/OS and use same environment for all comparison runs

revision_reason: Regional revision based on the data owner confirmation that only geography changed from the approved Google Trends collection process; recorded a passing fixed 2023 regional diagnostic and verified the regional preprocessing identities and frozen files.

execution.completed_runs: Reload verified checkpoints and results on rerun
execution.interrupted_training: Start a fresh same-seed attempt; preserve prior attempt files
execution.final_test: Claim the frozen test archive once in a persistent Drive ledger before loading targets; reuse completed report
execution.inference_timing: One warmed full-validation pass including batching and transfer, divided by examples, synchronized on GPU
